userDirection: Western classical architecture, clearly different from the previous hands composition, with title lettering.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished Chinese technical essay cover, panoramic 5:2 landscape, ideally 2000x800.
Create a sophisticated WESTERN CLASSICAL ARCHITECTURE editorial cover for an article titled "Agent Loop 核心流转与生命周期控制". The dominant subject must be an imposing Renaissance / Roman stone TOWER with an open cutaway revealing a beautifully looping staircase and stacked arched colonnades. Think Piranesi architectural copperplate engraving, Renaissance architectural treatise, an imaginative ancient observatory: intricately etched limestone blocks, round arches, vaulted loggias, a subtle domed roof, recurring circular stairs that return through multiple levels. It should feel monumental and contemplative, not medieval fantasy game art. One tower, not a crowded cityscape. The exposed circular staircase provides the Agent Loop metaphor, with a very fine restrained old-gold line quietly tracing one returning path through the stairs. No flowchart nodes, no software UI, no illustration mascot.

COMPOSITION:
New architectural composition, nothing resembling two hands touching. Use the right 55-60% for a large full-height monumental tower rendered in meticulously engraved charcoal/olive ink. A few partial antique stone arches in the far right establish depth; a low classical plinth anchors the tower. On the left 38-42%, a calm warm-ivory parchment field carries striking large typography. Generous margins and superb thumbnail readability. Slight overlap of architectural foreground and the quiet type field is permitted near the center, but never cover the lettering. Dramatic verticality of the tower against the very wide format.

TEXT, EXACTLY:
Small discreet letterspaced line near upper left: "自己动手构建 Agent"
Large dominant dark olive classical display serif title on the left, on two lines:
"Agent"
"Loop"
Below the English title, clearly legible Chinese Song/Ming-style serif subtitle, on two lines:
"核心流转与"
"生命周期控制"
No additional words, no chapter numbers. These texts must be accurately rendered, generous size, beautifully typeset rather than handwritten.

VISUAL STYLE:
Antique European book engraving on luminous ivory parchment. Muted olive-green and deep charcoal linework, restrained antique-gold accents, pale warm limestone. Keep the sophisticated classic Western visual atmosphere of an antique engraved architecture book. Thin elegant inset rectangular hairline border, small unobtrusive ornamental corner marks, subtle olive stone texture confined to the outer margins. Crisp crosshatched engraving details, airy cream negative space around the text, sophisticated visual hierarchy. Not a photograph, not glossy 3D, not a flat vector illustration. No giant hands, no hands at all, no floating logo medallions, no waveform, no interface boxes, no chibi character, no repeating the prior cover's scene. The architecture and the typography are the entire story.
